origine_fr: Une personne qui danse, des ornements aux mains : ce dessin a plus de 3 000 ans, et servait aussi pour 無. Plus tard, on a ajouté deux pieds, 夕 et 㐄. Le haut, celui de 無, donnait le son : 舞, c'est danser, la danse.
origine_en: A person dancing with ornaments in the hands: this drawing is over 3,000 years old, and also served for 無. Later two feet turned apart, 夕 and 㐄, were added below. The top, from 無, gave the sound: 舞 is to dance, a dance.
